frontend.description: URL of the PageKite frontend server to connect to. You can use a custom frontend or the public one.

httpport.description: Local port PageKite listens on for HTTP (non-HTTPS) requests from your web servers.

httpsport.description: Local port PageKite listens on for HTTPS requests (if using SSL termination on the frontend). Set to 0 to disable.

service_defaults.description: Optional base64-encoded secret for authenticating all services by default. If blank, per-service secrets apply.

services.description: List of services to expose. Each service tunnels a local address to a public hostname.

daemon.description: Run PageKite as a background daemon (true) or in the foreground (false).

pidfile.description: Path to write the PID file when running in daemon mode.
